verdict.rationale: The docs describe cloud sessions on the web that run long-running tasks on repos you don't have locally, so you can check back later (docs-26, docs-14, docs-13). Claude Code plans, writes code across files, 'verifies it works,' runs tests and opens PRs (docs-2, docs-16, docs-3). Feature work can also be kicked off from Jira or Slack and returns a PR for review (docs-30, docs-11). One hands-on user warns you can't trust it to self-verify (comm-16), which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: any demo artifact for review (preview deploy, screenshots or recording), explicit docs that the cloud sandbox runs builds and tests, and independent corroboration of the cloud workflow end-to-end.
